selection: Top 8 by same-direction nominally significant cancer count; ties by fewer reverse significant cancers, more evaluable cancers, more same-direction significant cohorts, chemical key
ccRCC_count: Either cohort significant in a direction counts ccRCC once for that direction; if significant opposite directions occur, record ccRCC in both direction-specific counts; never sum the two direction-specific counts as distinct cancer total
identity: Inherited KEGG/HMDB source keys, unique evaluable feature per cohort; no alias or peak pooling; no new chemical identification
